args: valid() { [ -n "$1" ] && [ -f "$1/.mcp.json" ] && [ -d "$1/bin" ] && { [ -f "$1/dist/server.js" ] || [ -f "$1/server.ts" ]; }; }; ROOT="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; valid "$ROOT" || ROOT=""; if [ -z "$ROOT" ]; then STALE=$(cat "$HOME/.claude/channels/rx-claude-matrix-bridge/plugin-root" 2>/dev/null); valid "$STALE" && ROOT="$STALE"; fi; if [ -z "$ROOT" ]; then for v in "$HOME"/.claude/plugins/cache/*/rx-claude-matrix-bridge/*/; do valid "${v%/}" && ROOT="${v%/}"; done; fi; if [ -z "$ROOT" ] && valid "$PWD"; then ROOT="$PWD"; fi; if [ -f "$ROOT/dist/server.js" ]; then exec node "$ROOT/dist/server.js"; elif [ -f "$ROOT/server.ts" ]; then cd "$ROOT" && exec npx --yes tsx server.ts; else echo "matrix-bridge: cannot locate plugin root (tried CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, plugin-root state file, plugin cache scan, PWD). Reinstall: claude plugin install rx-claude-matrix-bridge@arikw" >&2; exit 1; fi
